voice: ElevenLabs eleven_v4, Juanito (u1CVBnSUn9JiL8ssgd2v), Taglish, one take, split into lines, inner pauses capped at 0.45 s, atempo 1.0

lines.text: Sa madilim na daan, kapag may narinig kang umiiyak na sanggol sa damuhan, huwag kang hihinto.
lines.beat_before: hook: a jeepney's headlights on cogon grass, a white bundle in it, crying

lines.text: Sa probinsya, tiyanak ang tawag dito.
lines.beat_before: the empty provincial road at night: one jeepney, LAST TRIP on its signboard

lines.text: Parang bagong silang. Mag-isa. Nilalamig. Umiiyak, naghihintay na may bumuhat.
lines.beat_before: close: the bundle in the grass, a lampin, moving as it cries
the jeepney stops; the driver steps down into the grass

lines.text: Magaan pa sa una. Tapos, bumibigat.
lines.beat_before: inside under the fluorescent tube: he holds the bundle; his arms sag with its weight
the crying stops; the tube flickers

lines.text: Sabi ng iba, sila raw ang mga kaluluwa ng mga batang hindi nabinyagan. Sabi naman ng iba, mas matanda pa sila roon.
lines.beat_before: held silence; the lampin falls open: an ancient face on a baby body (stinger in silence); the tube goes out

lines.text: Sabi ng matatanda: kapag naligaw ka at narinig mo ito, baligtarin mo ang damit mo.
lines.beat_before: morning: the jeepney off the road, its back open, a pair of tsinelas on the step
close: the driver's shirt on the seat, turned inside out

lines.text: May mga driver na nakaalala sa tamang oras.
lines.beat_before: the road by day; tiny handprints on the windshield; then night again and the cry in the grass
